atom.claim: Camden involved ten courts under an all-weather canopy in a dead Homebase on Finchley Road, on a temporary consent.
atom.source_quote:
Camden is the one to watch. Ten courts under an all-weather canopy in a
dead Homebase on Finchley Road, on a temporary consent

atom.claim: Three of the ten were warehouse or industrial conversions.
atom.source_quote: Three of the ten were warehouse or industrial conversions

atom.claim: Carbon and Rocks Lane finished within a whisker of each other despite Carbon on seventeen courts and Rocks Lane on twelve.
atom.source_quote: Carbon on seventeen courts, Rocks Lane on twelve.
